cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Build a Coalition
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Sit with me for the allotment shed vote. It shouldn't look like just my project. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only support it if everyone gets a key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Shared keys. Agreed. Will you join me now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The new plot holders need to hear that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring them over. We can present it together as the shared-access proposal.

mechanism: A claims ownership of a shed proposal but grants shared access and presentation to recruit a broader group whose cooperation legitimizes A position.
confusable: Unlike collecting a signature alone, A changes the coalition terms and invites additional people; authority must yield ownership to keep that group willing.
comparison: An access-condition bargain with new plot holders differs from combining evening and weekend room users.
seedUse: Use current canonical D55-a shed/shared keys/new plot holders directly; S02-a decision adjustment is already enacted beyond the prefixed authority claim. Assess retention on actual behavior.
